listing:
  - id: validmind-notebooks-author

    grid-columns: 2
    max-description-length: 250
    sort: false
    fields: [title, subtitle, description]
    contents:
    - path: https://validbeck.github.io/docs/developer/validmind-library.html#b58fc729-690b-4000-b19f-365a4093b2ff7b7b3c2076617220766d2e70726f64756374203e7d7d-for-validation
      title: "ValidMind for validation series"
      subtitle: "Jupyter Notebook"
      description: "Created as part of an initiative to highlight our validation features that we previously neglected to showcase."
    - path: https://validbeck.github.io/docs/notebooks/quickstart/quickstart_validation.html
      title: "Quickstart for validation"
      subtitle: "Jupyter Notebook"
      description: "Created as part of an initiative to highlight our validation features that we previously neglected to showcase."

    type: grid
    grid-columns: 2
    max-description-length: 250
    sort: false
    fields: [title, subtitle, description]
    contents:
    - path: https://validbeck.github.io/docs/notebooks/use_cases/validation/validate_application_scorecard.html
      title: "Validate an application scorecard model"
      description: "I partnered with our Head of Solutions Architecture to author this intermediate notebook, transforming his domain knowledge into a comprehensive use case sample."
      subtitle: "Jupyter Notebook"
    - path: https://validbeck.github.io/docs/notebooks/use_cases/agents/document_agentic_ai.html
